meaning: Flow meter failure: Bosch says E14 indicates a flow meter failure or an issue with water flowing into the dishwasher or the filling system.
causes: A failed flow meter, the part that measures water coming into the dishwasher
A problem with water flowing in, or with the filling system
diySteps: Bosch gives no homeowner fix for E14: its only step is to contact Bosch Customer Support (1-800-944-2904)
Have your dishwasher model number ready before you call, as Bosch asks
Not the same as E16/E17 or E18: those are Bosch fill codes that come with homeowner checks, while E14 does not
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Bosch routes E14 straight to Bosch Customer Support. The flow meter sits in the dishwasher's fill system, so a failed one is technician work.
sourceTitle: Bosch Dishwasher Error Codes: Troubleshooting Guide (Bosch)
